skill.name: doc-sync
skill.description: Compares IdeaVim documentation with current code, APIs, working implementations, and Git history. It updates verified discrepancies while preserving established documentation style.
skill.summary: Verify and update IdeaVim documentation against current implementation details.
skill.author: JetBrains

security_audit.summary: All 18 backtick findings are false positives caused by Markdown formatting or documented, read-only search and Git commands. The network-scanning finding is also false because nmap appears only as text inside a grep pattern.

static_findings.snippet: - **Check git history:** Run `git log -10` on changed files, look for "remove" commits
- **Understand deletions:** Run `git show [commit]` to see what was removed

content.value_statement: Documentation often falls behind IdeaVim code changes. This skill compares documentation with current APIs, implementations, and Git history to correct verified discrepancies.
actual_capabilities: Compares documented function signatures and parameters with current IdeaVim APIs.
Checks code examples against working implementations in the repository.
Uses Git history to identify removals, deprecations, and breaking changes.
Finds documentation references related to changed code or APIs.
Updates verified documentation errors while preserving existing style and context.
limitations: The skill is tailored to the IdeaVim repository and its documentation layout.
It requires access to the relevant source code, documentation, and Git history.
It does not prove runtime behavior when implementation evidence is incomplete.
Large documentation sets may require a focused scope for thorough verification.

use_cases.title: Validate a documentation page
use_cases.description: Check one IdeaVim document against current APIs and working examples before review.

use_cases.title: Assess documentation impact
use_cases.description: Trace a code change to affected guides, examples, signatures, and file references.

use_cases.title: Review release documentation
use_cases.description: Inspect recent removals and deprecations for documentation changes before a release.

prompt_templates.title: Check one document
prompt_templates.prompt: Check doc/ideavim-mappings.md against the current code. Report verified discrepancies and update only inaccurate content.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a specific documentation file

prompt_templates.title: Review a code change
prompt_templates.prompt: Review changes to MappingScope.kt. Find affected documentation, verify every related example, and update confirmed errors.
prompt_templates.scenario: Documentation impact analysis after a code change

prompt_templates.title: Audit an API topic
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit documentation for mapping APIs. Compare signatures, named parameters, and usage patterns with current interfaces and working implementations.

prompt_templates.title: Perform a release sync
prompt_templates.prompt: Review recent breaking changes and removals. Audit all affected IdeaVim documentation, make precise updates, and identify unresolved evidence gaps.

output_examples.input: Check whether the mapping guide matches the current API.
output: Files checked: mapping guide, API definition, and one working implementation.
Discrepancy: one named parameter no longer exists in the current signature.
Update: corrected the example and preserved the surrounding explanation.

output_examples.input: Determine whether a recent class change requires documentation updates.
output: Git history and related documentation were reviewed.
No public API or documented behavior changed.

output_examples.input: Audit documentation after a removed mapping function.
output: Affected references were found in two documentation files.
Obsolete examples were replaced with the supported usage pattern.
One migration detail was marked for human review.

best_practices: Provide the changed code, target documentation, or commit range when possible.
Verify each edit against an API definition and a working implementation.
Review proposed documentation changes before merging them.
anti_patterns: Do not request broad wording improvements without an accuracy concern.
Do not treat documentation as proof when current code provides conflicting evidence.
Do not remove useful context only because an example requires correction.

faq.question: Can this skill update documentation from code changes?
faq.answer: Yes. It traces changed APIs and behavior to related IdeaVim documentation, then updates confirmed discrepancies.

faq.question: Can it verify code from documentation?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks documented signatures, parameters, and usage patterns against current APIs and working implementations.

faq.question: Which documentation files does it cover?
faq.answer: It targets the doc directory, README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, and other relevant IdeaVim documentation found during analysis.

faq.question: Does it change documentation automatically?
faq.answer: It can make precise updates when evidence confirms an error. Ambiguous cases are reported for human review.

faq.question: Why does it inspect Git history?
faq.answer: Git history reveals removals, deprecations, and earlier changes that explain why documentation may be outdated.

faq.question: Does it run or test documented examples?
faq.answer: It primarily compares examples with source APIs and working implementations. Runtime execution depends on the available project tools and task scope.
